name: digients-preview
description: Client-facing data-preview portal — browse the embodied-AI data taxonomy and preview video demos. Single always-on Node (Hono) process serving the built frontend, API, and on-disk videos.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,magenta "pnpm -C web dev" "pnpm -C server dev"
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -C web typecheck && pnpm -C server typecheck
